annotations.title: Look up known vulnerabilities for SBOM components

description: Scans the components and dependencies listed in a CycloneDX or SPDX JSON SBOM (software bill of materials) for known vulnerabilities (CVEs and other security advisories) by looking them up in the public OSV.dev database. Sends only the package URLs (type, name, version) and returns, per affected component, the advisory IDs, and for up to 25 advisories the summary, aliases (for example CVE IDs) and fixed versions, with the OSV source. At most 1,000 components with versioned package URLs per call; nothing is stored. A lookup by package identifier, not proof that the vulnerable code is used; no match does not mean no vulnerability. For the SBOM's contents and missing fields: sbom_summarize.

sbom_json.description: The full SBOM (software bill of materials) file content as JSON text: CycloneDX JSON or SPDX 2.x JSON listing the dependencies with package URLs (purl) and versions, for example from Syft, Trivy, cdxgen or npm sbom. Max 2,000,000 characters.
